decisions.reason: Captures 오죽하면 as causal ‘so bad that’; BASE omits that force.
Keeps the 말이야/방구야 sentence-or-fart joke; BASE genericizes it to ‘bullshit’.
천년설삼 is thousand-year snow ginseng; BASE’s Hundred-Year is a quantity error.
BASE calques 것 같은; SOL adds ‘stubborn’ and changes 설득 to ‘win over’.
decisions.replacement: I almost let myself be persuaded, but I quickly came to my senses. Somehow, I had to convince this old man who wouldn’t let even a needle through.

decisions.reason: SOL’s ‘Then, since I’m thirsty’ is stiffer; BASE keeps the deadpan two-beat request.
Unbolds the accept prompt and Y/N; bold is for labels, not whole System lines.
Rhetorical 하겠냐 is a scornful refusal; BASE’s ‘Was I going to?’ is weaker and more literal.
Absolute phrase is tighter English; dropping 느끼며 does not lose the boiling sensation.
Matches 못 하는 말이 없다; BASE is ungrammatical and understates the complaint.
솥뚜껑 is a pot lid, not a cast-iron pot.
Comma-versus-marker placement is merely typographic; no fidelity or prose gain.
할 만한 일 is work he still cares to do; SOL’s ‘worth doing’ plus ‘already’ widens the claim.
BASE’s ‘finally’ is not 오랜만에; SOL’s ‘after a long time’ is calqued.
decisions.replacement: It had been a long time since I’d met a formidable opponent.

decisions.reason: 씨부려 보게 is an invitation to speak; ‘do your worst’ turns it into action.
Easily granting a modest request is not ‘be happy to’; ‘even’ and ‘without a second thought’ match 정도 and 쉽게.
자네 정도면 is standing/level; ‘someone like you’ blurs that and sounds more dismissive.
한 솜씨 하는 is real skill; BASE’s ‘some skill of his own’ undersells it.
The line is muttered speech (꿍얼거린), not interior thought, so it takes quotes.
들으라는 듯이 is intentional audibility, not merely speaking loudly enough.
귀신같이 때려 맞추다 is uncanny accuracy; BASE’s ‘somehow’ weakens it.
SOL drops the article and makes the System line ungrammatical.
Glosses jiazi as sixty years in the existing footnote, which English readers need.
The footnote must explain the full title 천검진인; SOL only defines True Person.
